blocks.name: Mira Castellane
blocks.title: Staff software engineer and technical writer, Marlow Bay
blocks.quote: Twelve years building reliable data products for health and logistics teams, and explaining them in plain language. I like small, well-tested systems, clear documentation and teams that review each other's work kindly.

pages.title: Projects
pages.description: Selected projects by Mira Castellane: scheduling, pipelines, documentation and open source.

items.heading: Clinic scheduler (Brightwater Systems)
items.body: A booking platform for 140 clinics. Rebuilt the availability engine, cutting double bookings to almost zero and page loads by two thirds.

items.heading: Event pipeline (Foxglove Labs)
items.body: A fault-tolerant pipeline for 30 million events a day, with replay, schema checks and a dashboard anyone on call can read.

items.heading: Plainspoken (open source)
items.body: A small linter that flags jargon and very long sentences in documentation. About 900 stars and a very friendly issue tracker.

items.heading: The handbook (Brightwater Systems)
items.body: An engineering handbook of 60 short pages: how we review, release, respond to incidents and say thank you.

blocks.heading: Invite me
blocks.body: I give talks and run workshops on documentation, pipelines and kind code review. Write to me through the [contact page](/contact) with the date, the audience and the length you have in mind.

blocks.heading: Get in touch
blocks.note: I reply within a few working days. For roles, a short description of the team and the problem helps most. A PDF of this CV is a click away: use Save as PDF at the top of any page.
